work.headline: Real case studies: challenges solved with software and responsible AI
work.body: From MVPs to enterprise migrations, here is how we partner with fintech, insurance, e-commerce, manufacturing and more, shipping products that perform, scale and stay compliant.

fintech.challenge: No functional product, with automatic invoicing and integrated HR management, and no ability to grow or connect systems.
fintech.solution: MVP with an invoicing module, AI-powered invoice reading and processing, intelligent categorization and a fully integrated HR management module.
fintech.result: Robust product delivered in 3 months. AI-automated invoice categorization. Client team operational and autonomous from day one.

ecommerce.challenge: Old content-management system with no API of its own, no control over data and unable to integrate AI or grow the business.
ecommerce.solution: Full migration to a proprietary backend with API, dedicated database and integration of AI modules for personalization and automation.
ecommerce.result: Migration completed in 4 months with no downtime. Improved performance. Full control over data and a platform ready to grow with AI.

europacolon.challenge: Outdated institutional website, no admin platform and no email forwarding.
europacolon.solution: Modern new institutional website with a full admin backend, email forwarding and automatic AI analysis of contact requests, with categorization and prioritization before reaching the administrator.
europacolon.result: Website delivered in 6 months. Admin platform live from day one. Continuous maintenance service active.

fraud.challenge: Existing AI fraud-detection system needing improved performance, precision and platform development.
fraud.solution: Optimization of AI fraud-detection models for payments and e-commerce, plus active contribution to building and improving the company's tech platform.
fraud.result: AI models with greater fraud-detection precision, a more robust and scalable platform, delivered over 12 months of continuous collaboration.

insurance.challenge: Quotes website built on outdated systems, manual processes and no automation for the sales team, limiting growth.
insurance.solution: Full migration of all systems to modern technologies, improved quotes engine with AI and automation of sales-team processes.
insurance.result: Project completed in 18 months. Conversion up over 50%, significantly faster system and a more efficient sales team. Continuous maintenance active.

vmoove.challenge: No online presence, no admin platform and no automated processes, limiting acquisition of new clients.
vmoove.solution: Modern informational website, complete admin platform and AI processes to optimize operations.
vmoove.result: Website delivered in 4 months. Considerable increase in clients since launch.

manufacturing.challenge: Client factories with no visibility over their own production processes, no real-time data and unable to make informed decisions.
manufacturing.solution: Software with AI for factory monitoring and optimization, providing real-time data and insight into production.
manufacturing.result: Delivered in 8 months with an established maintenance plan. Clients gained greater knowledge and control over their factories, generating significant value.

maritime.challenge: Multinational with no digital platform for its clients and no AI processes, limiting operational efficiency and client experience.
maritime.solution: Full digitalization with a dedicated platform and AI processes integrated into operations.
maritime.result: Ongoing for 12 months. Platform launched with very positive results and significantly more efficient operations with integrated AI.

automotive.challenge: No functional product, no automated booking system and unable to forecast demand or proactively communicate with clients.
automotive.solution: MVP with a car-wash booking system, AI integration for demand forecasting and automatic next-wash notifications to clients.
automotive.result: Robust MVP delivered with an operational booking system, clients auto-notified via AI and ability to anticipate demand peaks from day one.
